info.title: Bazaarvoice Content Search API
info.description: Bazaarvoice Developer Space V2.0 Content Search API. Provides programmatic search and retrieval of user-generated content (UGC) - Reviews, Questions, Answers, Contributor profiles - plus product catalog lookahead search and structured data (JSON-LD/Microdata) for products. Assembled by API Evangelist from the per-operation OpenAPI definitions published on developers.bazaarvoice.com reference pages.

get.description: Retrieves structured data for a specific product. This is the recommended endpoint that accepts product-id as a query parameter.

parameters.name: client-id
parameters.description: The name of the client. Can contain special characters.

parameters.name: productId
parameters.description: The ID of the product. Can contain special characters.

parameters.name: Bv-Forwarded-User-Agent
parameters.description: Clients will need to send User-Agent of consumers accessing the PDP page

schema.example: Mozilla/5.0 AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko); compatible; ChatGPT-User/1.0; +https://openai.com/bot

parameters.name: User-Agent
parameters.description: Clients will need to send User-Agent of their backend http client

parameters.name: Accept
parameters.description: Accept header must be empty or omitted. The API will return the default content type (text/javascript) for now, in future this might change.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A JSON-encoded query object containing parameters for various content types. Refer to Bazaarvoice CV2 documentation for specific filter and sort values.

parameters.name: canonical
parameters.description: The exact identifier string used in your Product Schema's `@id` field. **CRITICAL REQUIREMENT:** For search engines to associate these reviews with your product, the string you send here **MUST BE IDENTICAL** (character-for-character) to the `@id` you assign to the Product object in your own schema generation. **Recommended Format:** Product Canonical URL + `#product` fragment.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Locale to display Labels, Configuration, Product Attributes and Category Attributes in. The default value is the locale defined in the display associated with the API key.

parameters.name: siteId
parameters.description: Site ID of the implementation, default will be main_site

200.description: Returns JSONLD by default for reviews and ratings.

Vary.description: Indicates which request headers affect the response
